axes.handedness: right-handed (Three.js); Unreal import: Z up, centimetres, Interchange converts

rules.areaAssignment: a point belongs to the first area whose centre is within its radius, else to streets; node extras.area carries it
rules.roadGraph: roads are the OSM ways life.js drives on (steps and the stadium footprint removed, same order and ids as life.js); two road ends within 6 m are joined
rules.pedestrians: walk along a road at offset width/2 + 1.5 m on either side (the pavement polylines here), footpaths (width <= 2) on the centreline; roads up to 12 m wide
rules.cars: roads 5 to 12 m wide, drive on the left at min(1.6, width/4) m from the centreline, 6 to 9 m/s, stop for anything within 8 m ahead
rules.heights: y is the game ground at that point: terrain + 0.06 on carriageway, + 0.14 on pavements
